# MASTER-UI-ENGINE

> A free, MIT-licensed library of 33 UI components, 15 worked screens and 6 complete page
> templates, written as plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript against one shared design-token
> stylesheet. All 33 components are also ported to React, Vue and Web Components. Its purpose
> is retrieval: an AI coding agent should reuse an audited component instead of generating
> generic UI from scratch.

Site: https://masterinterface.xyz
Source: https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine
Licence: MIT (https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/LICENSE)
Contact: open an issue on the GitHub repository — there is no sales team and no paid tier.

## What an agent should read first

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the instruction file a coding agent picks up automatically.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/SKILL.md): the installable skill, with the command list and the retrieval order.
- [Component catalog (JSON)](https://masterinterface.xyz/engine/showcase/data/component-catalog.json): all 54 entries with id, group, category, variants, tokens, audit notes and the frameworks each entry exists in. Read this before searching by eye.
- [Framework registry (JSON)](https://masterinterface.xyz/engine/frameworks/registry.json): per-component bindings for React, Vue and Web Components — source path, install line, import line, tag name and the dated verification note behind each status.

## Pages

- [Library](https://masterinterface.xyz/library): search and filter the 54 entries; every preview is the real file, not a screenshot.
- [Templates](https://masterinterface.xyz/templates): 6 starter pages and 15 worked screens, rendered live.
- [Agent integration guide](https://masterinterface.xyz/agents): the three surfaces an agent uses — instruction files, the `mue` CLI, one machine-readable registry.
- [FAQ](https://masterinterface.xyz/faq): testing scope, what `stable` means and does not mean, licence terms, framework coverage.
- [Visual lab](https://masterinterface.xyz/engine/showcase): browse all previews with a command palette, viewport and theme controls.
- [Token studio](https://masterinterface.xyz/engine/showcase/studio): edit the token ramps and read the resulting WCAG contrast ratios.

## Commands (no install, no npm package)

```bash
node tools/mue.js stack                       # which stacks really ship source
node tools/mue.js search "data table"         # find an entry by what it is called
node tools/mue.js show ui-cards               # copy-ready markup for the vanilla file
node tools/mue.js show ui-cards --framework vue
node tools/mue.js add ui-cards --framework react --into ./src   # component + the layers it needs
node tools/mue.js registry --json             # the whole registry, machine-readable
node tools/mue.js check all                   # unresolved classes and missing metadata
node tools/audit/framework-parity.mjs         # statuses vs the checks that earned them
```

## How to use it correctly

1. Retrieve before generating. `mue search`, then `mue show` — the markup, props and accessibility
   notes come from the file itself, not from a description of it.
2. Take the layers together. `mue add` copies the component plus `design-tokens/engine.css` and
   `styles/components.css`; a component without the token layer renders unstyled.
3. Write the shared classes, never new CSS. The three framework ports only emit classes defined in
   `styles/components.css`; `tools/audit/check-classes.js` fails on a class that does not exist.
4. Respect the status vocabulary. `stable` means the binding was driven in headless Chrome and Edge
   at 1280px and 390px in light and dark, with axe-core runs recorded in the registry. It does not
   mean Safari, Firefox, a screen reader, a touch device, server-side rendering or npm publication
   were tested — none of those have been run, and the site says so on every page that shows a status.
5. `planned` means an architecture document and no source. Svelte and Angular are planned for all
   33 components. Asking for them returns that answer rather than a placeholder.

## Verification, honestly stated

- Checked: build or serve, live gallery, behaviour probes at 1280px and 390px in light and dark,
  axe-core (0 serious/critical), WCAG AA contrast, no horizontal overflow at 320/375/768/1280,
  in headless Chrome and Edge. Recorded run date: 2026-11-01.
- Not checked: Safari, Firefox, screen readers, touch devices, SSR, load or Lighthouse figures,
  npm publication, production adoption.
- Full record: [Framework support](https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/docs/framework-support.md),
  [Contributing](https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md),
  [Resource and licence index](https://github.com/STEVOHCODER/master-ui-engine/blob/main/RESOURCES.md).
